Description.Name: Julia Clark
Description.Details: Raised on a mercenary stronghold on Cassia, Julia grew up surrounded by BattleMechs with her sister Amanda. They were both later trained at the renowned Blackstar Academy, becoming highly skilled MechWarriors. Julia's elegant finesse and innately protective nature earned her the moniker "Angel", while her sister's fiery nature and daring approach earned her the callsign "Firefly". A falling-out over the morality of a complex mission caused the sisters to go their seperate ways. However, they still hold an unbreakable bond, and maybe one day they will reconcile.
